title: Skills layout and packaging script
goal: One command writes an Agensi-ready zip per skill from skills/<name>/
acceptance: npm run skills:package writes dist/skills/<name>-<version>.zip with SKILL.md at the root, LICENSE and the bundled files only
A test covers the zip layout and that a missing SKILL.md or frontmatter fails
skills.md says how a skill is packaged and that publishing is a manual upload
privacy: Skill and tool text only; examples invented; no personal data.
escalation: A skill that cannot stand alone without restating a harness rule goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-14: a small Node script and its test; zip through a maintained library or the system zip.
